publisher_edition: Texas Education Agency December 2014 Chapter 111 Subchapter A

rows.scope: Recall basic addition and subtraction facts within 20 with automaticity.
Add up to four two-digit numbers and subtract two-digit numbers using place-value and operation-property based mental strategies and algorithms.
Solve one-step and multi-step addition/subtraction word problems within 1,000 with varied place-value strategies, including algorithms.
Generate and solve problem situations for a given mathematical number sentence involving addition or subtraction of whole numbers within 1,000.
Determine the value of a collection of coins up to one dollar.
Use the cent symbol, dollar sign and decimal point when naming the value of a coin collection.
Model, create and describe contextual multiplication by joining equivalent groups of concrete objects.
Model, create and describe contextual division by separating concrete objects into equivalent sets.
